component.name: AuTopsy
component.summary: Multitrack audio editing with synchronized video on Windows

description.p: AuTopsy is an independent fork of Audacity's audacity3 audio editor. Its Windows video extension adds native video tracks, smooth preview, split and trim editing, and export with the edited audio mix.

ul.li: Convert tapes and records into digital recordings or CDs
Edit WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP2, MP3 or Ogg Vorbis sound files
Cut, copy, splice or mix sounds together
Change the speed or pitch of a recording
Apply a wide range of other effects to audio recordings
